description: Complete, cross-platform solution to record, convert and stream audio and video.

global_option.name: -abort_on
tip: Abort transcoding on the given condition (e.g. empty_output, flags).

global_option.name: -acodec
tip: force audio codec ('copy' to copy stream)

global_option.name: -aframes
tip: set the number of audio frames to output

global_option.name: -attach
tip: Attach a file to the output file as a specific type.

global_option.name: -auto_conversion_filters
tip: Automatically insert conversion filters where needed.

global_option.name: -bits_per_raw_sample
tip: Set the number of bits per raw sample.

global_option.name: -bsf
tip: Apply a bitstream filter to the output.

global_option.name: -copyinkf
tip: Copy initial non-key frames along with the first keyframe.

global_option.name: -copypriorss
tip: Copy and edit the priority of the stream.

global_option.name: -copytb
tip: Copy the time base of the input to the output.

global_option.name: -copyts
tip: Copy the input timestamps to the output instead of offsetting them.

global_option.name: -cpucount
tip: Limit the number of threads used by the CPU.

global_option.name: -cpuflags
tip: Set CPU capabilities to the specified set (e.g. avx, sse4).

global_option.name: -dframes
tip: Set the number of data frames to output.

tip: set display horizontal flip for stream(s) (overrides any display rotation if it ...

global_option.name: -display_rotation
tip: set pure counter-clockwise rotation in degrees for stream(s)

tip: set display vertical flip for stream(s) (overrides any display rotation if it is...

global_option.name: -drop_changed
tip: Drop frames whose data has changed unexpectedly.

global_option.name: -dts_delta_threshold
tip: Set the DTS delta threshold for timestamp correction.

global_option.name: -dts_error_threshold
tip: Set the DTS error threshold for timestamp correction.

global_option.name: -filter_buffered_frames
tip: Filter buffered frames in the output.

global_option.name: -filter_complex
tip: Apply a complex filtergraph to the streams.

global_option.name: -filter_hw_device
tip: Set the hardware device used for hardware filtering.

global_option.name: -filter_script
tip: read stream filtergraph description from a file

global_option.name: -find_stream_info
tip: read and decode the streams to fill missing information with heuristics

global_option.name: -fpre
tip: Read options from the given preset file.

global_option.name: -fpsmax
tip: set max frame rate (Hz value, fraction or abbreviation)

global_option.name: -frames
tip: set the number of frames to output

global_option.name: -fs
tip: set the limit file size in bytes

tip: when dumping packets, also dump the payload

global_option.name: -init_hw_device
tip: Initialize a hardware device with the given name.

global_option.name: -isync
tip: Synchronize the input streams by their timestamps.

global_option.name: -lavfi
tip: Use the given filtergraph as a virtual input.

global_option.name: -map
tip: Map the specified input stream(s) to the output.

global_option.name: -map_chapters
tip: Map the chapter metadata from the given input.

global_option.name: -map_metadata
tip: set metadata information of outfile from infile

global_option.name: -max_alloc
tip: set maximum size of a single allocated block

global_option.name: -max_error_rate

tip: Set the maximum size of the muxing queue.

tip: Set the maximum size of data buffered in the muxing queue.

global_option.name: -print_graphs
tip: print execution graph data to stderr

global_option.name: -print_graphs_file
tip: Print the filtergraph description to the given file.

global_option.name: -print_graphs_format
tip: Set the format of the printed filtergraph description.

global_option.name: -profile
tip: Set the profile of the codec.

global_option.name: -q
tip: Set the quality (VBR) of the output.

global_option.name: -r
tip: set frame rate (Hz value, fraction or abbreviation)

global_option.name: -re
tip: read input at native frame rate

tip: allow recasting stream type in order to force a decoder of different media type

tip: reinit filtergraph on input parameter changes

tip: force subtitle codec ('copy' to copy stream)

global_option.name: -sdp_file
tip: Write an SDP description of the output to the given file.

global_option.name: -shortest_buf_duration
tip: Set the duration of the shortest buffering.

global_option.name: -sinks
tip: list sinks of the output device

global_option.name: -sources
tip: list sources of the input device

global_option.name: -spre

global_option.name: -sseof
tip: set the start time offset relative to EOF

global_option.name: -start_at_zero
tip: Start the output timestamps at zero.

global_option.name: -stats_enc_post
tip: Print encoder statistics after encoding each frame.

global_option.name: -stats_enc_pre
tip: Print encoder statistics before encoding each frame.

global_option.name: -stats_period
tip: Set the interval between statistics reports.

global_option.name: -stdin
tip: enable or disable interaction on standard input

global_option.name: -stream_group
tip: Attach the stream to the given stream group.

global_option.name: -stream_loop
tip: Set the number of times to loop the input stream.

global_option.name: -t
tip: record or transcode "duration" seconds of audio/video

global_option.name: -tag
tip: Set the tag of the output stream.

tip: specify target file type ("vcd", "svcd", "dvd", "dv" or "dv50" with optional pre...

global_option.name: -thread_queue_size
tip: Set the maximum number of queued packets from the demuxer.

global_option.name: -timelimit
tip: Set the maximum time to transcode.

global_option.name: -timestamp
tip: set the recording timestamp ('now' to set the current time)

global_option.name: -vcodec
tip: force video codec ('copy' to copy stream)

global_option.name: -vframes
tip: set the number of video frames to output

global_option.name: -vstats
tip: Dump video coding statistics to a file.

global_option.name: -vstats_file
tip: Dump video coding statistics to the given file.

global_option.name: -vstats_version
tip: Set the version of the video statistics file.

global_option.name: -vsync
tip: Set the video sync method (e.g. passthrough, cfr, vfr, drop).

global_option.name: -xerror
tip: Exit with an error on any error, even if it would normally be ignored.
